comment: Floors for the Vocadito accuracy test (README.md): the percentage of voiced reference frames where the detector's reading, folded to the reference's octave, is within 50 cents. Set on 2026-11-26 from the first measured run (vocadito_2 100.00, vocadito_4 98.09, vocadito_6 99.39, vocadito_26 94.44, vocadito_35 98.74, overall 98.27 %), rounded down to 0.1; they only ever rise.
